title: Celestial Terrace
safeHtml:
Celestial Terrace is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the East Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-15.

Contents

History[]

Contrary to Intuition, the name of this District is not of Astronomical Origins. Instead, it is a lament of the developet of Asylum with regards to the high heavens taking away things that he liked.

Original plans of Celestial Terrace involved a School Village complete with Public Housing. However, after the School Village plans were cancelled, it was replaced by Public Housing in the form of Lei King Estate.

The north coast of Celestial Terrace, which is now known as Woodside Gate, is a large-scaled reclamation area. Only one Private Housing Project was planned in the vicinity of Woodside Gate, which is now called Territorial Bay. However, subseqeuntly, a new Interior Shopping Street is planned near the Promenade, and is one of the few Shopping Spaces in Asylum which involved two stories or more. Lei Ming Estate, located at the West of the Reclamation Area, is added on later planning stages. Several of the block also enabled views to the Woodside Gate Strait and East Point Bay, making that Estate one of the best Public Housing Estates in Asylum.

Station Characteristics[]

  • This station is the 300th station to be built in the Los Sengas Division.
  • Similar to Midway Island Node Before it, this station is built entirely on an artificial island.
  • While the Builder of Nazca Railway had explicitly mentioned that this station would NOT be classified in any Station Class, the NR Dex of this station had shown that this station is of Terminal-class. As a result, the Station Usage column of this station writes Terminal.
  • Despite not containing the word Terminal, as the number of Platforms for all Standard Railway lines involved in this station is identical to that of Terminal-class Stations in the regards that each direction has two platforms, this station can be seen as a Terminal-class Station.
  • This Station features the first pair of Cross-platform interchange between two different Veloducts.
  • This Station has the second most number of Platforms behind Metropolis Terminal.

Fun Facts[]

  • This page is the 2600th page of this wiki.
  • The first background image of This Wiki was taken at the Premium Lounge of this Station.
  • This Station began construction on June 21 2020, but did not begin services until 17 days later on July 8 2020.
  • The Structure of this station had previously been plagiarised and appeared in another server.[13]
  • The Station Structure is 1100m long, and takes reference to Arsenal Bird, the boss in Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown. The reference is also evident from the fact that the North and South Wings of this station are named "Justice" and "Liberty" respectively, and the wingspan of Arsenal Bird is also 1100m wide.[14]
  • The Station Floors of this Station takes reference of an Airport with a Departure Concourse and an Arrival Concourse.
  • The North Wing and South Wing of this Station uses Blocks of Gold and Blocks of Diamond respectively. The Station Control Room of this Station is located at the Central Wing of the Arrival Concourse this station.
  • The Outdoor NR Shops and Outdoor Entry Gates of this station takes reference to Metro Stone Station and Greenrock Hill Station[15] and Aest Station[16] respectively.

Future Development[]

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

  • Hotel Line will use this station as the Permanent Down Direction Terminus. From Here, it will extend to Xofa.
  • This Station will feature Local Rapid Transit services that may cover the entire Centopia Island.
  • The Shuttle will arrive at this station. However, facilities for The Shuttle will not be built until the development for The Shuttle begins for this station. The Platforms of The Shuttle may be placed below the Zephyr Line, Sparkling Line, Alpha Line, Hotel Line Platforms of this station, and would NOT go directly to Metropolis Terminal.[17]

History[]

  • June 21 2020: This Station began construction.
  • June 25 2020: The Island on which this station is located (Centopia) completed reclamation works. At the same day, the Centopia Section of Centopia Bypass copmleted construction.[18]
  • June 27 2020: The Station Structure of this station began construction, and the Utopia Line Station Number is announced.[19]
  • July 1 2020: This Station experimented on the Simplified Chinese Version of the NR Song.[20]
  • July 2 2020: The Station Structure and Platform Structure of this station completed construction.[21]
  • July 5 2020: The Main Structure of this station completed construction.[22]
  • July 6 2020: Centopia Depot Completed construction.[23]
  • July 8 2020: This Station completed construction and began services alongside Daring Line, but Utopia Line, Zephyr Line, Sparkling Line, Alpha Line and Hotel Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • July 27 2020: Alpha Line extends from Comp Ward Station to this Station. Alpha Line completed construction, and uses this station as its Permanent Down Direction Terminus.
  • May 19 2021: Utopia Line extends from Chromafringe Station to this station, and temporarily uses this station as its Up Direction Terminus.
  • August 29 2023: As Utopia Line extends to Kioku Station, Platforms 5, 6 began operations.
  • November 18 2023: This station completed setting up of Sparkling Line systems.
  • November 19 2023: As Sparkling Line extends to Hakeem Station, Platforms 17, 18 began operations.
  • November 30 2023: Exit C is added to this station to connect to Orama Island.
  • December 17 2023: This station completed setting up of Zephyr Line systems.
  • December 18 2023: As Zephyr Line extends to Leben Station, Platforms 9, 10 began operations.
  • September 5 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[24]

title: Centopia Depot
safeHtml:
Centopia Depot is one of the depots of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It is located at Los Sengas Centopia, and is the train base for Daring Line and Utopia Line. With a Capacity of 130 nine-carriage trains, this depot had exceeded Vector Bay Depot as the largest Depot in Nazca Railway and was the Main Center of Operations for all lines in Los Sengas Division. However, the record has been re-held by Vector Bay Depot after the expansion for Lima Line of completed in August 23 2024.

Description[]

This Depot is constructed to the east of Centopia and serves Utopia Line and Daring Line trains, as well as spare trains from other lines. Trains may access this depot through Blu Trove Bay Station Platform 3 or Durandal Station.

Centopia Island is one of the islands involved in the Centopia Nazca Railway Headquarters. This island is an artificial island, is also the main island of the Centopia District, and is the first island involved in the Nazca Railway Headquarters.

Location[]

Centopia Island is located at the center of Centopia District. In terms of districts, it is located to the south of Peckern and the northwest of Twenty-Second Continent. In terms of islands, it is located to the southwest of Kioku Island, the east of Orama Island, the southeast of Hakeem Island and the northeast of Leben Island.

Transport[]

Railway[]

Centopia is the station that serves as the hub of this island, as well as the Nazca Railway Headquarters as a whole. It is currently served by Utopia Line, Daring Line, Zephyr Line, Sparkling Line and Alpha Line, and will feature Hotel Line, an unknown Standard Railway line and an unknown Veloduct in the future, with possibilities of The Shuttle reaching it.

Trunk Roads[]

Currently, this island features 6 different access roads, one in the form of Route 11 that provides connections from this island to Peckern to the north and Twenty-Second Continent to the south. Additionally, a road is also built by the developer of Twenty-Second Continent to access the Java Bay area, with access roads connecting to Kioku Island, Hakeem Island, Orama Island and Leben Island respectively.

Road[]

(To be added)

Facilities[]

Centopia[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Centopia.

Centopia is the station that serves as the hub of this island. It is located at the center of this island in terms of the island length, and leans slightly to the west of this island in terms of the island width. It is also located to the south of North Parking Lot 2 and the west of Centopia Depot. Moreover, it also provides footbridge access to Orama Island.

Centopia Premium Lounge[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Centopia Premium Lounge.

Within the structure of Centopia lies Nazca Railway's first Premium Lounge, free for use of all passengers travelling to this island.

Centopia Depot[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Centopia Depot.

Centopia Depot is located to the east of the station structure of Centopia. It serves as the train base for Daring Line and Utopia Line, and has a Capacity of 130 nine-carriage trains. It is also the Main Center of Operations for all lines in Los Sengas Division and is currently the largest depot in Nazca Railway.

North Parking Lot 1[]

The North Parking Lot 1 is located at the northwesterly side of the island beneath Daring Line tracks and Utopia Line tracks to the north of Centopia. This Parking Lot features 1,300 Parking Spaces in total.

North Parking Lot 2[]

The North Parking Lot 2 is located directly to the south of North Parking Lot 1 and the north of the station structure of Centopia. The west part of this parking lot, above which the Daring Line and Utopia Line tracks pass through, is similar to that of Parking Lot 1. However, the east side of this parking lot has four storeys that provides more parking spaces. A footbridge is also built connecting this parking lot with the flea market to the east.

Flea Market[]

The Flea Market is located to the east of North Parking Lot 1 and North Parking Lot 2, and to the west of Centopia Depot tracks and the North Park. This flea market features picnic tables to the west side starting from the North End to the Footbridge connecting to North Parking Lot 2, where tourists can rest after making purchases. From the South End to the aforementioned footbridge, the picnic tables are replaced by gardens instead.

It also features a total of 118 booths at the center, with three lavatories and benches at the east side close to the Centopia Depot, where tourists can make brief breaks during purchases. A tiny parking lot featuring a total of 60 Parking Spaces is also seen at the north.

South Park[]

The South Park is located at the southeasterly corner of the island to the east of Centopia Depot tracks. The South Park features three lavatories, one to its north boundary, one at the center and one to the south. This Park features a triangular garden to the west of the north lavatory, followed by a maze to its direct south.

To the south of the maze exists a rest area featuring the central lavatory at its west, rectangular picnic tables at its center and round picnic tables to its east, which in turn serves as a food court that is built in a fashion similar to Metropolis Phase III. At the south boundary of the park lies a fountain which is surrounded by a trapezium-shaped garden, and a tiny parking lot that serves this park also exists across the road that connects this island with Leben Island.

North Park[]

The North Park will be located at the northeasterly side of the island to the east of Centopia Depot tracks.

South Parking Lot[]

The South Parking Lot will be located at the southwesterly side of the island to the south of the hotel.

Hotel[]

The Hotel will be located directly to the south of the station structure of Centopia and to the north of South Parking Lot.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Island is 2300m long and 750m wide, with a 100m radius on each point of the island.[1]
  • The Name of this island would be used in a movie of The Same Name. However, the naming of this island and that movie are not related to each other.
  • The channel that exists between Kioku Island to the northeast and this island is 150m wide.
  • The channel that exists between Orama Island to the west and this island is 400m wide.
  • Except for Centopia, Centopia Depot, North Parking Lot 1 and North Parking Lot 2, all other facilities on this island have been sub-contracted to other developers in Los Sengas due to slow development progress.

Flea Market[]

  • The Flea Market features a total of 190 picnic tables, with each picnic table having a capacity of four tourists. This means that the picnic tables can serve up to 760 tourists in total.
  • The 118 booths at the Flea Market are divided by eight different areas, with each area having a distinct theme that defines the unique building material used for each booth, and the Booth Numbers increase from north to south and from west to east.
  • All booths feature oak fences and dark oak fences as support, with Chiseled Quartz Blocks on the roof. Hence, to avoid color confusion with the unique building material for each booth, all white building materials, Oak Woods and Dark Oak Woods are eliminated from being the signature building material of each booth and are instead used at the boundaries of each zone.   • The east passageway of the flea market features three sets of lavatories and a total of 52 benches, each with a seating capacity of two people. This means that the benches at the east passageway can accommodate a total of 104 people, and when the picnic tables are considered, a total of 864 people can simultaneously rest at the Flea Market.

South Park[]

  • There is more than one possible path to traverse from the south to the north of the maze and vice versa.
  • The Rest Area features a total of 12 rectangular picnic tables and 14 round picnic tables, with each rectangular and round picnic table having a capacity of ten tourists and six tourists respectively. In total, the rest area can serve up to 204 tourists.
  • The Food Court at the Rest Area features Bread, Cookies, Cooked Porkchops, Steaks, Cooked Chickens, Cooked Muttons, Cooked Fish, Cooked Salmon, Apples, Melon Slices, Carrots, Baked Potatoes, Pumpkin Pies and Mushroom Stews.
  • The Parking Lot that serves this park features a total of 283 Parking Spaces.

History[]

  • June 25 2020: This island completed reclamation works. At the same day, the Centopia Section of Centopia Bypass copmleted construction.
  • June 27 2020: The Station Structure of Centopia began construction, and the Utopia Line Station Number is announced.
  • July 2 2020: The Station Structure and Platform Structure of Centopia completed construction.[2]
  • July 5 2020: The Main Structure of Centopia completed construction.[3]
  • July 6 2020: Centopia Depot Completed construction.[4]
  • July 8 2020: Centopia began services alongside Daring Line.
  • July 27 2020: Alpha Line began serving Centopia.
  • May 19 2021: Utopia Line began serving Centopia.
  • August 5 2023: The road link to Kioku Island completed construction.
  • September 5 2023: This island completed construction of North Parking Lot 1.
  • October 8 2023: Sub-contracts for The Flea Market, the North and South Parks, the South Parking Lot and the Hotel on this island have been open to other developers on the Official Discord Server.
  • October 10 2023: This island completed construction of North Parking Lot 2.
  • October 21 2023: The Flea Market completed construction.
  • November 3 2023: The road link to Hakeem Island completed construction.
  • November 19 2023: Sparkling Line began serving Centopia.
  • November 30 2023: The footbridge between Centopia and Orama Island completed construction.
  • December 2 2023: The road link to Orama Island completed construction.
  • December 18 2023: Zephyr Line began serving Centopia.
  • December 29 2023: The road link to Leben Island completed construction.
  • March 1 2025: South Park completed construction.[5]

The Centopia Premium Lounge is a Premium Lounge that is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division). It is located at the Departure Concourse level of Centopia.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Premium Lounge Facilities
  • 3 Fun Facts
  • 4 Gallery[4]
  • 5 Citations and References

Description[]

This Premium Lounge is located at the north side of the Central Wing of the Departure Concourse in Centopia. It is a one-storey structure that is located directly opposite to the large Station Signs signifying Utopia Line, Daring Line, Sparkling Line and another currently unknown Standard Railway Line.

Premium Lounge Facilities[]

First Floor (L1, Y=75)
  • Reception Area
  • Newspaper Area
  • Lavatories and Bathrooms
  • Buffet Area
  • Dessert Area
  • Internet Bar
  • Storage Area
  • Bedrooms

Fun Facts[]

  • This is the first Premium Lounge to be built in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • The first background image of This Wiki was taken at the Reception Area of this Lounge.
  • This Premium Lounge, despite its name, is free for Entry for everyone who arrives at Centopia.
  • This Premium Lounge features the following newspapers (With the Bracket to the right denoting its point of origin):
    • Inter-Galactic Media Group (IGMG) (Los Sengas)
    • World Gazette (Los Sengas)
    • The Wilde Street Journal (Los Sengas)
    • The Los Sengas Times (Los Sengas)
    • Venus Times (Los Sengas)
    • The European (Los Sengas)
    • Metro (United Kingdom)
    • The Sun (United Kingdom)
    • Yomiuri Shimbun (Japan)
    • The Asahi Shimbun (Japan)
    • Mainichi Shimbun (Japan)
    • Liberty Times (Taiwan)
    • United Daily News (Taiwan)
    • China Times (Taiwan)
    • Apple Daily (Hong Kong)[1]
    • Ming Pao (Hong Kong)
    • The Epoch Times (United States)[2]
    • Passion Times (Hong Kong)
    • South China Morning Post (Hong Kong)
    • LS01 (Los Sengas)
  • The Buffet Area of this Station features Snacks from across the world, including: Los Sengas Fried Rice, Ramen, Kitsune Udon, Mixian, Wagyu, Cha Lua, Curry Potatoes, Corn, Siu Mai, Curry Fishballs, KFC-styled Mushroom Rice, Saizeriya-styled Meat Doria, IKEA-styled Meatballs, Fried Chicken, Pastel de Nata, Bacalhau, Tempuras, Sushi, Sashimi and Budae-jjigae. Moreover, Drinks, such as tea, coffee, dairy beverages, juice, soda and beers, and Desserts, such as Jelly, Pastries, Salad, Nuts, Biscuits and Turkish Ice Cream, are available.
  • Storage Areas are available for people who use the Bedrooms and the Internet Bar at the Premium Lounge.
  • Television Screens are available at lavatories. This design alludes to the K11 Musea Shopping Mall in Hong Kong.[3]

Central Line was the first line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between City Hall and Quin Biome, and had a total of 10 stations. It was established alongside City Hall Station on August 27 2012. However, on March 10 2015, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Description[]

Central Line was the first District Railway line in Terracept NR to be established. It traveled across central Terracept in an east-west orientation.

This line was represented by Light Blue on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 1.

At the time of its closure, this route was 10.44 km long, with a total of 10 stations.

  • August 27 2012: City Hall - Admin

  • January 10 2013: City Hall - Wathill
  • February 18 2013: City Hall - Watesert
  • May 29 2013: City Hall - Watesert (Carboflame Inserted between Admin and TriSwamp)
  • July 25 2013: City Hall - East Surrest (Line Complete)
  • August 20 2013: City Hall - Quin Biome (East Surrest handed over to Eternal Line)

Line Charcteristics[]

  • The first line to be established and to complete development in Terracept Division.

Fun Facts[]

  • While East Surrest Station used to be a station of this line, since the establishment of Eternal Line, operations of East Surrest Station had been handed over to Eternal Line.

Central Numpool Station/Node is a station on Pegasus Line and The Shuttle. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to Metro Express Transport Leanpool Line (Numpool West Station).[2]

Fun Facts[]

  • The color scheme of this station alludes to Numpool Station.
  • In order to avoid the clashing of Pegasus Line tracks and The Shuttle Tracks, all platforms of this station are at different altitudes as Pegasus Line needs to go to Miner North Station to the southeast whereas The Shuttle Tracks go directly to the south.[3]
  • Contenders of the names of this station included West Numpool Station and New Numpool Station. However, the former shares name with the Metro Express Transport Numpool West Station, which also happens to be further west on Numpool Island than this station, and as this station is built at the naturally generated part of Numpool Island, the latter is also discarded. Moreover, it is also unfeasible to rename the existing Numpool Station into East Numpool Station due to the works that might be involved in station renaming.[4] Ultimately, the name Central Numpool Station is used.

History[]

  • November 3 2021: This Station began construction.
  • November 4 2021: This Station completed construction. The Shuttle part is open to the public, but Pegasus Line Platforms remain reserved and closed to the public.
  • November 6 2021: This station began services alongside Metropolis Link, Midway Island Link and Old Brightland Link.
  • March 5 2022: The Pegasus Line Part of this station is now open to the public. At the same day, Pegasus Line extends from Seat River Station to this station.

Centre Line is a line that runs from the northeast of Earn Island to the southwest, and connects the northern and southern parts of Earn Island together by rail. It currently has five stations.

  • This line is one of the two lines in Earn Island Light Rail operated by BatistaCity Transit.

Charlie Line is a Veloduct of NR Los Sengas Division. With 8 stations along the line, this line was established on September 11 2016, and runs between Potato Farmland and Winter Point.

Description []

Charlie Line is one of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It starts at Jupiter and heads north into TriPaw, before passing through the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals to reach the Metropolis Terminal. Afterwards, it reaches Sava, passes through Youngsters and Ingress, before reaching Winsol at Winter Point Gateway.

This line is represented by Light Yellow on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number C.

This line shares structure with West Ring Line between Numpool and Miner North, and briefly shares tracks with Minecraft Line between Miner North and Tai Wan Peninsula.

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • The section between Metropolis and Tai Wan Peninsula features the longest slope in Nazca Railway. The slope starts at Y = 28 in Metropolis Terminal to Y=115 near Numpool Station in a slope of 1:10, before descending back to Y = 68 near Tai Wan Peninsula Station.
  • This line has emergency platforms at Cyan Loop Station (Between Metropolis and Polibiomes).
  • This line provides Express Services for the following lines:
    • East Ring Line: Metropolis to Thick River (Through Polibiomes) [1]
    • Minecraft Line: Tai Wan Peninsula to Potato Farmland (Through Europa)
    • Ingress Line: Chilly Canyon to Winter Point
  • This line may extend to Arctic Sea Station in the future.

title: Checkpoint
safeHtml:
Checkpoint (Referred to as "Cpt" in this wiki) is a Station Class in Los Sengas. It is a class below Gateways, and is followed by Area Stations. Currently, there are 13 "Checkpoint-Class" Stations in Los Sengas.[1]

Contents

  • 1 Definition
  • 2 List of Stations
    • 2.1 Nazca Railway [2][3]
    • 2.2 Peckern Transit
  • 3 Fun Facts
  • 4 Citations and References

Definition[]

The early definition of Checkpoints were inconsistent, as Rover Down was defined partly due to its pioneering test of new station facilities. However, since Katadelphia North and Edward Island are defined as checkpoints, the definition has since been clearer.

In 2020, Nazca Railway has described the requirements for a station to be defined as Checkpoints, including the potential for developments around the station, choices inside and outside railway network and districts connected by the station. Simply taking choices for interchanging inside the railway network, all Checkpoints now feature at least 4 lines, either having services upon completion of station or planned to serve in future. Though, this is not the only requirement to categorize a station as Checkpoint, nor a must.

List of Stations[]

Nazca Railway [2][3][]

  • Urban Line, Urban Express, Luxter Line, Golf Line Rover Down Checkpoint
  • Arcgo Line, Alpha Line, Muiga Line, Muiling Line Katadelphia North Checkpoint
  • New Edward Line, Kinight Line, Interisland Line, Bravo Line Edward Island Checkpoint#
  • New Edward Line, Cometsilk Line, Phoenix Line, Starshore Line, Delta Line, Kilo Line Nail Bight Checkpoint
  • Minecraft Line, Oasis Bay Line[4], Charlie Line, Echo Line, Stadow Line Europa Checkpoint
  • Urban Line, Urban Express, Oasis Bay Line[5], Echo Line Tat Stone Hill Checkpoint#
  • Luxter Line, Origin Line, Abyss Line, Egress Line, Alpha Line, Fox Line, ARIES Line Sand Martin Checkpoint
  • New Edward Line, Daring Line, Akashi Line, Bravo Line Le Monde Checkpoint#
  • Stadium Line, Flask Line, Bravo Line, Phoenix Line, Coopol Line Flask East Checkpoint#
  • West Ring Line, Luxter Line, Sava Line, Phoenix Line West Shoal Checkpoint#
  • Pegasus Line, Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line, Lima Line, Old Brightland Link Old Brightland Checkpoint/Node#
  • Oasis Bay Line, Phoenix Line, Echo Line Cyban Checkpoint

Peckern Transit[]

  • Northland Line, Eastcoast Line, Metro Line, 'KTR Light Railway Grand Squirrel Checkpoint

Fun Facts[]

  • A common characteristic of Checkpoints is that most of them are located at the edge of the district which it belonged to. The only two exclusions from such characteristic are Flask East and Europa respectively.
  • Nazca Railway planned three "Super-checkpoints" in Season 3 which would have significantly more lines serving the station than usual Checkpoints. The first super-checkpoint is Europa and Tat Stone Hill (these two were originally planned as one single checkpoint), the second being Sand Martin. As for the third and final super-checkpoint, Winter Point Gateway, it is no longer categorized as Checkpoint as it is now a Gateway instead.

Citations and References[]

  1. ↑ The Number of Checkpoint-Class Stations is very likely to increase to 16 in the future.
  2. ↑ Checkpoints marked with the "#" symbol are Checkpoints that were originally Area Stations but became Checkpoints later on.
  3. ↑ East Ring Line, Luxter Line, Origin Line, Fox Line, Kilo Line Daisy Island Checkpoint and Glacier Line, Glacier Express, Arcgo Line, Charlie Line Arctic Sea Checkpoint will become checkpoints in the future.
  4. ↑ Formerly served by West Oasis Bay Line.
  5. ↑ Formerly served by West Oasis Bay Line.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Crown Heights.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "From Abyss to Aether".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Crown Heights 03:38

Fun Facts[]

  • The Chinese Name of this station alludes to CinozFX, the developer of Rover District[2], and the English Name of this Station alludes to the fact that the developer was in Czechia at the time of its construction.
  • The playful color scheme of this station is derived from the fact that the area has plans to become a leisurely conservation area.[3]

History[]

  • January 17 2025: This Station began construction.
  • January 19 2025: This Station completed construction.
  • January 21 2025: This Station began services.
  • July 17 2025: The Station Icon of this station is added.

Chick Isle is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. It neighbors Peckern North to the west and Eagle Island to the east.

Transport[]

Prior to the regeneration of Eagle Island, this isle was accessible through Eagle Light Rail at Chick Isle Station, where visitors would make use of a footbridge to reach this isle. However, since the demolition of Eagle Light Rail and the regeneration of this isle, Chick Isle no longer accessible on foot. As of today, only a part of the footbridge on Eagle Island remains as a historic site.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Blizzard Fissure.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Particles and Pinnacles".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Blizzard Fissure 03:42
Cryostrat Drift 03:46

Fun Facts[]

  • This station adopts the Spanish Solution for all its platforms. However, for this station, Ingress Line Platforms and Charlie Line Platforms alternate with each other to facilitate transfer.
  • This station is the first and currently the only station to use the Generation 4.5 Departure Routine in Los Sengas Division, with the Generation V Departure Routine being used in the now-defunct Heaven Pacific Division. A prominent characteristic of this Departure Routine is that, a single departure routine controls two different platforms at once. While North Mountain Station and Ingress South Station also has two platforms on both sides, two different departure routines are activiated when trains depart from these stations, whereas this station uses one departure routine controlling two platforms.[3]
  • The Charlie Line tracks between this station and Thick River Station is 10590m long, and involves sharing routes with Ingress Line, Route 10 between Saber Tower Station and Circle Pit Station and East Ring Line between Spike End Station and Saber Tower Station, before going under the Thinbeach Tunnel using the 2nd Thinbeach Tunnel.

History[]

  • February 27 2018: The Platform Structure and Electromechanical Systems of this station completed construction.[4]
  • March 3 2018: This Station began services.
  • October 11 2021: The Ingress Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[5]
  • July 17 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[6]

Chosen Surge Station is a station on Stadium Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Festival. Passengers may also use this station to change to Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line (Chosen Surge Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • Bodies of Water exist on the floor of the concourse and at the sides of the tracks.
  • This Station is sister stations with Jumper Swamp Station. However, this Station uses Green Wool instead of Blue Wool.
  • The Name of this Station is a beautification of the Original name at which this station is located (Chuk Shui Kwai). In Cantonese, this name refers to the never-ending stagnant waters around this station due to the it being located at a Swamp.
  • The Lavatories of this station is located to the East of the Platforms due to Structural issues.
  • This station shares structure, exit numbers and fare zones with Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line Chosen Surge Station.

History[]

  • June 24 2021: This station began services.
  • August 29 2025: Exit E is added to this station to connect to the Paleblue Railway Station of the Same Name.[2]

Fun Facts[]

  • The Blocks of Quartz, Blocks of Gold and Blocks of Diamond allude to the Design of Centopia in order to tell passengers that this station approaches Centopia. Moreover, Pink Wool is also used in this station to allude to the name of this Station.[2]
  • Iron Bars are applied vastly in this station to pay tribute to New Edward Line Station designs within Twenty-Second Continent. However, unlike the New Edward Line Stations, which mainly uses Stone, this station mainly uses lighter colors.
  • The Waiting Passageway is also referred to as the "Sub-Concourse" and connects to the Chromafringe Bus Terminal above. All Platforms at the Bus Terminal, from Platforms 1 to 17, have direct stair connection to the Waiting Passageway.

History[]

  • May 18 2021: This Station began services. Utopia Line is established.

Station Floors and Facilities (Description)[]

North Concourse[]

The North Concourse is a Concourse directly belonging to East Ring Line, and is the only concourse among the four concourses to be located at Ground Level. The North Concourse has an elevator and a set of stairs connecting to the East Ring Line Platforms, with direct access to the East Concourse at the Non-Entry Gate Area. The North Concourse has a Minecart claim area, a recycle bin, 4 shops and station facilities, with Access to Exit A.

East Concourse[]

The East Concourse is a Concourse that also directly belongs to East Ring Line. This concourse is situated to the east beneath the East Ring Line Platforms. The East Concourse has three sets of stairs and two elevators connecting to the East Ring Line Platforms. Inside the Entry Gate Area are two shops, a Minecart Claim Area and Station Facilities, and outside the Entry Gate Area are recycle bins. Between the Passageway to two elevators is a branch that connects to a toilet, with direct access to the North Concourse at the Non-Entry Gate Area. Moreover, a Corriodor exits at both inside and outside the Entry Gate Area connecting to the South Concourse. The East Concourse features Exits B1 and B2, with these two exits being stair exits and elevator exits respectively.

West Concourse[]

Similar to the above two concourses, the West Concourse also directly belongs to East Ring Line. This concourse is at the same Depth (Y Coordinaets) as the East Concourse, except that this concourse is located to the West. The West Concourse has two sets of stairs and an elevator connecting to the East Ring Line Platforms. The Non-Entry Gate Area only occupies a quarter of the surface area of this concourse, with no direct access to other concourses outside the Entry Gate Areas. The West Concourse features Station Facilities, Los Sengas Coffee and three shops, featuring Minecart Claim Areas and Recycle Bins in and out of the Entry Gate Area. A passageway connecting to the center of the South Concourse also exists in the Entry Gate Area. The West Concourse Features Exit C, which is simultaneously an elevator exit and a stairs exit.

South Concourse[]

The South Concourse is a Concourse that directly belongs to Arcgo Line. Among the four concourses, this Concourse is the Largest, and is also the only concourse that adopts a significantly different color scheme from the other Concourses. The structure of the South Concourse is similar to other underground Nazca Railway Stations, and is as wide as the Arcgo Line Platforms beneath it while being only 90% of its length. The South Concourse has four sets of stairs and an elevator connecting to the Arcgo Line Platforms, featuring a single entry gate area and two unconnected Non-Entry Gate Areas. While the Non-Entry Gate Area to the South features Exits D and E, the North Non-Entry Gate Area features Exit F and access to the East Concourse. Moreover, passageways to the East and West Concourses also exist within the Entry Gate Area, complete with all Basic Station Facilities, Minecart Claim Areas, Recycle Bins, Station Teleportation and the Station Control Room. Since the completion of the Mushroom Transit Circle Pit Station, Exits G1, G2 and G3 are also connected to this Concourse, with Exits G2 and G3 being inside the Entry Gate Area, and G1 being outside the Entry Gate Area.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after the fact that a circular pit exists near the station.
  • This station is the largest and most structurally complex interchange station built in Season 2, Episode 9.
  • The structure of this station alludes to Kowloon Tong Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.
  • With the East Ring Line Platforms of this station being 53 meters wide, this station used to have the widest pair of Island Platforms in Los Sengas Division. However, it would later be replaced by the East Ring Line Platforms of Wooden Abyss Station at 55 meters.
  • This station was jokingly referred to as having "Four Bedrooms and Two Living Rooms".

History[]

  • December 28 2016: This station began services alongside East Ring Line, but Arcgo Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • December 31 2016: Arcgo Line extends from Peaceful Steps Station to this station.
  • July 24 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]
  • August 4 2021: Three exits are added to this station (Exits G1, G2 and G3) to connect to the Mushroom Transit Station of the Same Name.[4]
  • June 27 2026: This Station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]
